source.runtimeWeight: PejAiAnimator.meleeLayerWeight; EnterMelee/ExitMelee linear DOTween over 0.1 second

fire.interpolation: periodic linear position/scale and shortest-arc quaternion interpolation over base phase, action time, then native layer-weight knots

timeDomain.baseTime: raw source base-clip seconds; walk/run are periodic over [0,1)
timeDomain.actionTime: raw default-right-pistol fire source-clip seconds over [0,2]; controller state speed is 8

activation.source: AnimCtrl_EnemyMain layer 4 Shooting; default PejAiAnimator LeftRight=1; pistol Weapon=0
activation.entry: Conditionless IdleLeftRightBlend (zeta:rig|fullbody-idle-0, speed 1) -> RangeAttacks_BlendTree; fixed 0.1 second duration; no exit time
activation.active: RangeAttacks_BlendTree resolves LeftRight=1 and Weapon=0 to zeta:rig|main-pistol-strzal-epsilon; duration 2 seconds; state speed 8
activation.exit: RangeAttacks_BlendTree -> IdleLeftRightBlend at normalized exit time 0.875; fixed 0.1 second duration
activation.invocation: No managed Animator.Play/CrossFade targets Shooting.RangeAttacks; Shoot trigger is consumed by melee/melee-weapon layers, not Shooting.
activation.externalLayerWeight: normal path: (1-meleeLayerWeight)*(1-meleeWeaponLayerWeight)*clamp(_alertness/alertDelay,0,1), optionally replaced by GunfightLayerBlend.Value, then multiplied by 1-clamp-grab where grab>=0.5 yields zero and lower grab uses 1-2*grab
activation.alertness: _alertness += deltaTime*WeaponSpeedMultiplier*WeaponPrepareMultiplier; alertDelay default 0.5; WeaponPrepare writes +1 for that controller update; AlwaysAlert calls SetFullyAlerted
activation.runtimeControllerObservation: Isolated AnimatorControllerPlayable with LeftRight=1, Weapon=0 and layer 4 weight 1 remained in Shooting.IdleLeftRightBlend for 0.8 seconds; the serialized conditionless edge did not activate.
activation.webActivation: Caller must supply explicit Web attack intent and must not describe a projectile-event restart or periodic cycle as recovered native invocation.

limits: Default right-handed pistol branch only: LeftRight=1 and Weapon=0.
External native layer weights are sampled at 0.5 and 1 with implicit raw-base weight 0; native 0.25/0.75 hold-outs bound interpolation.
Locomotion transitions use endpoint precomposition; native hold-outs bound that approximation.
Shooting entry/exit uses effective weight = external gun-fight weight * captured controller-state blend; native entry/exit hold-outs bound that approximation.
Run reuses the exact walk leaf grid; its controller speed remains caller timing.

sourceIdentity.evaluation: Exact source AnimationClip through native AnimationClipPlayable and AnimationPlayableOutput; AnimatorController detached before clone activation

runtimeSampling.evaluation: Exact source AnimationClip through native AnimationClipPlayable and AnimationPlayableOutput; AnimatorController detached before clone activation

death.status: native death is ragdoll physics; no motion synthesized

weaponAttachment.coordinates: Column-major socketUnityLocalMatrix * H; H=diag(-1,1,1,1) maps X-reflected scene weapon coordinates to Unity bone coordinates. Source weapon mesh-local offsets remain the weapon renderer's responsibility.

source.selection: PejAiAnimator._Awake sets LeftRight=1; GetWeaponSocket selects WeaponSockets; WeaponType.Pistol=1
source.attachment: WeaponSocket.AttachWeapon parents PejAiWeapon to socket; PejAiAnimator.UpdateWeaponRotation settles its local position/rotation to zero/identity; PejAiWeapon.Setup resets pickup local TRS to identity
source.pose: Final v8 sampled wrist including locomotion transitions and native fire precomposition; no independent socket animation channels
source.limits: Right-handed pistol only; no target-dependent AimIK, pickup settling tween or drop/ragdoll simulation
